goal: Allow applications using libbitcoinkernel to validate blocks without maintaining a full UTXO set
Enables lightweight or custom UTXO indexing architectures to verify individual blocks
agreement: Unaddressed objection: caller-supplied lookup callbacks allow non-deterministic lookups (ajtowns)
Nonblocking objection: ancestor blocks under assumevalid skip script checks (nervana21)
Support for callback design and tested against downstream bindings (alexanderwiederin, ismaelsadeeq)
Concept approval without stated reasons (w0xlt, yuvicc)

categories.name: kernel
why: P2 because it significantly expands kernel API completeness for downstream consumers
External applications can verify blocks using custom UTXO indexing instead of a full chainstate

categories.name: validation
why: P3 because it exposes an alternative check-only execution harness rather than changing core node behavior
It remains worthwhile for consensus verification but is deferrable from a core validation perspective
